comm-nonrenewal-notice.subject: Notice: your plan will not renew in Lorain County
comm-nonrenewal-notice.text: Northlake Advantage Plus (HMO) will not be offered in Lorain County after December 31, 2026. You can choose another plan during the annual enrollment period or afterwards through a special enrollment period. If you do not choose a plan, your Medicare Advantage coverage ends on December 31, 2026 and you return to Original Medicare.

comm-voicemail-2026-10-19.name: Voicemail from Dottie Hayes
comm-voicemail-2026-10-19.subject: Voicemail from Dottie Hayes
comm-voicemail-2026-10-19.text: Hi, this is Dottie Hayes. I got a letter that my Northlake Advantage Plus plan is ending in December and I don't know what to do. I need to keep Dr. Brennan and my heart doctor, Dr. Sullivan. I take Eliquis and Jardiance, plus my cholesterol pill and metformin. I'm on a fixed income, so I really can't pay more than about thirty dollars a month. Dental coverage would be nice to have, but it isn't a must. Please call me back or email me, but please don't text me, I don't read those. Thank you.

source.label: Communication log: Voicemail from Dottie Hayes
